hooks.command: out=$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads/agent/ 2>/dev/null | while read -r b; do n=$(git rev-list --count main.."$b" 2>/dev/null); [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] && echo "  $b: $n commit(s) ahead of main"; done); [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s\n%s\n' 'Pending sub-agent submissions (merge with: git merge --no-ff <branch>):' "$out"; exit 0
